comment: Round 173 Direction 1: Shrine Tower definitions. A Shrine is a pure-buff tower with NO auto-attack, NO projectile, and NO enemy targeting. Its only role is to apply a persistent radius-based buff to all friendly towers in TowerShrineRadius. Four aura types: 0=None/inert, 1=Gold (+X gold per kill on towers in range), 2=Mana (+X mana regen/s on towers in range), 3=Damage (multiplier on tower attacks in range), 4=AttackSpeed (multiplier on tower cooldown in range). The PlaceTower post-init defaults to a Gold-buff shrine (aura=1, radius=3, potency=0.10); this JSON documents the v1 template values designers can override.

shrines.name: Gold Shrine
shrines.description: +0.10 gold per kill on friendly towers in 3 cells

shrines.name: Mana Shrine
shrines.description: +0.5 mana regen per second on friendly towers in 3 cells

shrines.name: Battle Shrine
shrines.description: +8 percent damage on friendly tower attacks in 2.5 cells
